{{Quote|I wouldn't want to deal with her. She doesn't care about money. She's into... other things.|[[Ann'ya]]|<ref name="TOR:CV">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Confronting Veeboo|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The '''Lady of Pain''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] operating on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|She works for the Exchange. They're into a lot of sick stuff. She can't get enough of it.|Ann'ya|<ref name="TOR:CV" />}}
An organizer of gladiatorial fights and a member of the [[Exchange]],<ref name="Lady of Pain" /> the Lady of Pain eventually came across the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Gault Rennow|Tyresius Lokai]], a target in the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] in [[3643 BBY]]. When Lokai's [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] came to her [[Lady of Pain's compound|compound]], the [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] organized a gladiatorial match between the hunter and [[Borga (Gamorrean)|Borga]], a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] under [[Fell Dargun]]. The hunter emerged victorious, but Lokai managed to escape from the Lady of Pain's custody before he could be handed over to the hunter.<ref name="TOR:ABwtLoP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lady of Pain was voiced by actress [[Nika Futterman]], who also did the voice of [[Asajj Ventress]] for the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|TV series ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']].
